ModMetaData.name: RimStation 14
ModMetaData.author: nexomeow
ModMetaData.description:
This mod is inspired by the legendary "Space Station" game series, drawing references from both *SS13* and *SS14*.
Meet the faction known in the media as "The Syndicate." Embark on a life of crime: deploy saboteurs and agents, or cause massive explosions as a Nuclear Operative.
P.S. The mod is in the early stages of development and currently focuses on the Syndicate.
